Furthermore, Bob does tell the Ninja that Milton Dyer was seeking revenge after being fired which prompted the Ninja to believe Milton Dyer was Unagami.

Level Thirteen[]

The Ninja head to Borg Tower to get the analysis of the Prime Empire. Borg told the Ninja that they had to defeat Unagami in the virtual world or find Milton Dyer in the real world. Cole then starts to play the game.

While he is playing, The Mechanic's team attempts an invasion. The Ninja are forced to stay in Borg's office, so they check on Cole only to realize that he didn't start the game and is still choosing an avatar.

Cole is able to reach level thirteen, but The Mechanic's team finally reaches the top floor. The Ninja are able to defeat The Mechanic's team before Cole, Lloyd, Nya, and Kai successfully entered Prime Empire.

Once they arrived, they would admire their surroundings as they looked around the marketplace.

Superstar Rockin' Jay[]

Lloyd and his friends continued to look for Jay inside Prime Empire until they are attacked by the Red Visors. He along with the rest of the Ninja attempt to use Spinjitzu and their Elemental Powers, but only end up getting dizzy from spinning with no tornado forming around them and doing Jazz hands. As they duck for cover, Kai reminiscences the time Aspheera stole his powers and berates on how he and his friends always seem to lose their powers. He then witnesses "Jay" fighting a Red Visor and calls to his friends about this, who seem to also see other Jays fighting. Confused on why there was more than one Jay, Cole explains that they are some of the people trapped inside the game and made their avatars look like Jay. When they spot drones coming, the Jays tell them to follow as they double jump to the rooftop. Cole tells them what the double jump was and Kai told him that made no sense, but went with it anyway as the drones followed them.

Being cornered by drones from all sides, the Ninja and Jay Avatars fight the drones. The Jay Avatars being easily able to take them out, while the Ninja struggle with one of their own. Kai jumps on the face of one drone but is blasted off easily by its laser, sending him flying off the building and killing him. Kai then respawns next a grieving Lloyd after seeing his death. Both Kai and Lloyd are confused and Kai is impressed that he just respawned. Following Jay's advice, they head to an alleyway below after hearing a codename.

The Ninja suddenly spot three Red Visors up ahead. Lloyd, Nya, and Cole hide, but Kai, thinking the game has unlimited lives, stands in the open and taunts the Red Visors. The Red Visors kill him and Kai respawns again after the Ninja defeated the Red Visors. Kai re-spawns and expresses how much he likes the ability of "infinite lives". Cole tries to tell him how lives in a video game really works, but Kai ignores him as they move on.

Arriving at the location, which was an empty parking lot, the Ninja are confused by the turn of events; Kai concludes that the Jay avatars are crazy since they love Jay so much when a masked stranger holds them at gunpoint. Nya tells him the code name the Jay Avatars mentioned earlier and the man invites the Ninja inside his hidden garage.

The man reveals his name to be Scott and what he's been doing in Prime Empire when Kai foolishly kills himself by touching one of Scott's belongings; That being explosive. Upon re-spawning, Kai tells Scott how cool it is to have infinite lives. Scott denies this and shows him his health board, which is down to one. Kai gets mad at his friends for not saying anything and Cole responds by saying when he did try helping him, but he didn't want to hear anything.

I am Okino[]

The ninja enter Terra Karana with Kai and Jay arguing about the League of Jays. The Ninja then see a depressed Okino and honor him if he could guide them through Terra Karana.

The Glitch[]

Lloyd and the rest of the Ninja head out with Okino into the Forest of Discontent. Their first obstacles are bushes which contain the Thorns of Discontent. Lloyd is able to dodge the bushes and destroy one.

As the team and Okino travel through the forest, they complain about the darkness and not being able to see. Jay then opens his inventory and pulls out two torches for him and Cole. The problem now is that they could see what danger awaited for them.

As they continue walking, Nya accidentally jumps into a pit. She then begins to sink into it as teeth surround her. Jay and Cole attempt to pull her out in vain and Nya screams as the sand and teeth swallow her. Respawning, Nya is upset as well to see that she has also lost a life.

Okino and the Ninja eventually reach a point where he thinks the upcoming obstacle could be Strangler Vines. Lloyd finds out it's not, but they are ambushed by the Whack Rats. The Ninja defeat the Whack Rats and Ritchie is tied up. They interrogate him and Ritchie reveals that Unagami ordered them to ambush the Ninja. Lloyd then comments about Unagami preventing the Ninja from winning the game which confuses Okino. The Ninja then explain that Prime Empire is not a real-world and Unagami is the creator of the world. Originally, Okino doesn't believe it causing Jay thinks he is not programmed to understand the truth.

Realizing Unagami is playing dirty, the Ninja are about to leave, but Ritchie urges the Ninja to cut him down because he has an itch. Ritchie then tells the Ninja that there's a glitch in the game that can allow the Ninja to bypass the Forest of Discontent. The Ninja end up letting Ritchie down and he begins scratching his body.

Ritchie guides the Ninja to the glitch and he jumps in. Okino is confused at the sight as the rest of the Ninja enter as well. The Ninja are teleported to a purple cubed room. They walk forward and all of a sudden, the Red Visors appear and begin shooting the Ninja. The Ninja pull out their prime controllers to defend themselves as Ritchie looks on before leaving the room. The Ninja begin to lose lives until Okino enters and fights the Red Visors allowing the Ninja a chance to escape. Everyone but Lloyd is able to escape because Lloyd wants Okino to come along. Okino decides to stay with Lloyd as he pushes him through the portal.

The Ninja and Okino land outside the Forest of Discontent. Lloyd thanks Okino, but he is kneeling realizing the world he lives in is not real. Okino thinks he's a pawn, but Lloyd downplays the idea as he tells Okino that he made his own decision, not Unagami. Lloyd then tells Okino to trust in himself and in the Ninja as friends and as an ally to help them get past Terra Karana.

The Cliffs of Hysteria[]

The Ninja talk to Shifty who gives them a discount on the grappling hooks for Flower Nya". Shifty then offers them two ropes: the Rope of Supreme Durability and the Rope of Questionable Integrity. Shifty lists the price for the first rope at a massive price that the Ninja can't pay. Jay refuses to buy the Rope of Questionable Integrity and suggests gaining more credits or to steal the rope. However, Lloyd doesn't agree with both ideas and opts to take the cheaper rope.

The Ninja are forced to take the second rope and Red Visors arrive at the scene. The Ninja begin climbing the cliff with the Red Visors on their tails. Lloyd defends himself by using his prime controllers and takes a Red Visors with him before he goes to the top.

As the Ninja interrogate one of the Red Visors, it tells the Ninja that Unagami is constructing something to another place and Jay realizes it's Ninjago. Lloyd tries to demand more answers but it self-destructs. After gaining more information, the Ninja are about to head into the Maze of the Red Dragon, but Okino continues to doubt himself. Lloyd tells Okino that he can be himself and make his own decisions which inspires Okino to be himself.

The Maze of the Red Dragon[]

The Ninja and Okino begin dashing through traps and just before Cole asks Okino where to go, Unagami pauses the game to speak with Okino. When the game unpauses, the Ninja ask again, and Okino begins guiding the Ninja.

They make it to where the Red Dragon is and the Purple Key-Tana. Lloyd attempts to steal it when the dragon is sleeping, but the Ninja accidentally awakens it when they save Jay. Cole and the Ninja struggle to attack the Red Dragon until Okino strikes the dragon on its weak spot. The Ninja begin striking that same point until Jay grabs the Key-Tana and takes out the remaining lives.

One Step Forward, Two Steps Back[]

Jay introduces Terra Technica to the Ninja and they decide to sign up for the Speedway Five-Billion. Unfortunately, they don't have enough credits to enter the race, and, to make matters worse, they are surrounded by Red Visors. Jay fights one of them and is forced to have a weapon upgrade which causes them to need more credits once they are done fighting. They then see an advertisement for a dance competition and decide to enter in order to obtain more credits.

Jay and Nya begin dancing and rank up points rapidly. This impresses the rest of the Ninja as they didn't realize Jay is an excellent dancer.

Meanwhile, the Red Visors begin to show up, so the Ninja begin fighting them in the background. Eventually, Jay and Nya are able to win the contest, and fans begin rushing the stage to congratulate them. One Red Visors tries to craw his way towards Jay and Nya, but Kai pokes his back and punches his head.

After winning the competition, Jay and Nya cash out their earnings to enter the race. The Ninja then realize they need cars, but Jay claims he knows someone who can lend them cars, so they head out to Scott.

Racer Seven[]

Scott shows the Ninja all of the vehicles he has and commented that he wouldn't race due to having only one life left. Jay replies by saying that some things are worth fighting for, but Scott doesn't want to be a hero. Jay then explains that Scott has been in the game for way too long.

While the rest of the Ninja are working on their vehicles, Lloyd heads out to check out the track. During his time, he catches sight of an unknown racer who wipes out despite racing hard. In fury, she throws her helmet at Lloyd. All of a sudden, Lloyd is spotted by multiple Red Visors and runs away onto the racing pole. He then does a backflip and lands on a car before escaping through a pit stop.

While Nya is working on her car, she falls down and Jay checks to see if she's okay. Nya then gets upset that her vehicle is now destroyed, but Lloyd comes back telling the team that he thinks Racer Seven can drive. However, Scott reveals that Racer Seven is programmed to lose which gets affection from Jay and Nya. Lloyd then goes out to find her.

After some time, Lloyd finds Racer Sven and tells her that the world she currently lives in is not real and that she is programmed by Unagami to lose. Racer Seven downplays that and threatens to call the Red Visors if he doesn't move. Lloyd then leaves but tells Racer Seven to come to the empty parking lot if she changes her mind.

After a grueling day, the Ninja rebuild four vehicles but still need another one. That's when Racer Seven arrives, so the Ninja and Scott come out to greet her. Lloyd then asks if she will participate or not.

The Speedway Five-Billion[]

While the Ninja are talking to Racer Seven, the alarm sounds as Red Visors begin shooting the base. Lloyd said he would hold them off, but the Ninja won't let him, so Scott decides to hold off the Red Visors. The Ninja are able to escape, but Jay cries out when Scott is cubed.

The Ninja are able to enter the race. After Coe and Kai decide to sacrifice themselves, Jay and Nya scream for their friends while Lloyd hangs his head down in despair while Unagami's drones pick up the cubes.

The Whack Rats then attempt to move Racer Seven out of first, but the Ninja get in their way. Racer Seven crosses the finish line first and wins as everyone cheers.

Jay, Nya, Lloyd, and Racer Seven are the crowned the winners of the race and handed the Yellow Key-Tana. Seven hands it to Jay, as he states that they can make Unagami bring their friends back. They just have to get the Orange Key-Tana and confront him. Red Visors begin to appear again and Seven tells them she can handle this. The remaining Ninja run away as the Red Visors confront Racer Seven and asks where they are. Seven plays dumb and they claim Unagami will find the Ninja. Seven denies this and says that the Ninja will be going after Unagami instead.

Stop, Drop and Side Scroll[]

The remaining Ninja - Lloyd, Nya, Jay - head through Terra Technica and sneak past Red Visors. As they move, they watched of replay Kai and Cole being cubed from the Speedway Five-Billion, discouraging them. Lloyd tells the two of them that Kai and Cole would want them to keep on moving, which they do so. Jay shows them to the last Arcade Pod that would take them to the next area, Terra Domina.

When arriving, they find themselves in a side-scrolling platform, where they have to beat all the levels to reach the end. Jay describes how this works: As they keep moving, the ground will disappear behind them and will go faster as they progress, as they keep moving they will need to dodge objects and falling bricks if one of them dies, they all have to start over. As Nya questions the last rule, she is hit by a giant swinging sledgehammer with spikes, killing her.

The trio respawn back at the beginning, with Nya on her last life. Lloyd expresses his annoyance about having to repeat that again. Jay tells them if they pay attention, they can do this. As they get farther, Jay passes three of the same hammers that killed Nya earlier. As he flosses in his victory, he barley evades a falling brick. As he laughs at the brick, another one falls and crushes him.

They respawn back at the start again, now with Jay standing on his last life. They move on again and Lloyd gets blocked by a giant wall. He tries to double jump over it but doesn't have enough room to get high enough. Instead, he hits the wall and falls to his death.

The three respawn back at the beginning once more, now with all of them down to one life. Jay tells them that they can't afford any more mistakes. This time, they make it through the first section.

The music gets faster and Jay realizes this as the game is getting harder. They are then greeted by an infinity maze going upwards and the floor slowly disappearing beneath them. They travel upwards and after a while, they slowly get tired. Just as they think the side-scroller is endless, Nya gets a Loot-Box and unlocks the ability to perform Airjitzu. Jay and Lloyd tell Nya to go on without them but says for them to grab and hold tight and flies up to the top.

When they arrive at the top, they find themselves having to choose a champion to face their most dreaded challenger and obtain the Orange Key-Tana. Lloyd is chosen and walks in the fighting arena. Unagami chooses and spawns Lloyd's most dreaded challenger, which was Harumi, which surprises Lloyd. Jay and Nya try to warn him of what Unagami is doing, but a dome blocks them from entering the arena and mutes their voices from the inside.

Harumi starts by tricking Lloyd to make him not want to fight her and seizes the opportunity to get the first hit on Lloyd. Lloyd holds back, not wanting to fight her. Jay and Nya try to tell Lloyd to fight her since this was not the real Harumi, but their efforts were useless. Lloyd starts making counter-attacks on Harumi, and as Harumi locks swords with Lloyd, she tries to trick him by saying that she was sorry for everything. Lloyd asks Harumi if it was really her. Jay again tries to warn his friend, but cannot due to the dome interfering. Lloyd breaks away from Harumi and proves if this was really her by asking her what they did the first night they were alone together. When Harumi answers incorrectly, Lloyd sees through this, realizing that this was not the real Harumi. Harumi and Lloyd start trading hits and blows that each other, both at low health now. Both make a final charge at each other and make a final attack on each other. Harumi dies first, while Lloyd loses his final life, turning into an Energy Cube and getting absorbed by a drone.

Jay and Nya obtain the Orange Key-Tana, but they mourned over Lloyd being cubed. Jay then tells Nya that they will stop Unagami and finish it for those who were lost.

Game Over[]

Lloyd and the other ninjas are freed from Prime Empire and returned to Ninjago. There, he reunited with Jay, Wu, Zane, and P.I.X.A.L. and notices Racer Seven smiling at him, knowing that she's thanking him for helping her. While the Ninja are wondering what happened to Unagami, Jay reassures them that, like everyone else trapped in Prime Empire, he's home.

Master of the Mountain

Master of the Mountain[]

Shintaro[]

Lloyd catches Cole slacking off and is instead playing video games while the rest of the ninja are doing their chores. However, Lloyd decides to join in.

Sometime later, Lloyd finds Wu in a depressed state and their master explains that he feels like he's no longer needed as the ninja were able to successfully carry out their missions without him. Lloyd tells Wu that he's still needed, but he walks away.

Lloyd then heads outside to hear that they're being invited to Princess Vania's birthday at the Kingdom of Shintaro. Wu also heads outside and Lloyd tells Wu about the good news and recommends he should come along, but Wu does not want to go. However, Wu ends up going along after Misako forced him.

Lloyd and the ninja head to the Ivory City via the Bounty. Along the way, they encounter the Dire Bats. One even attempts to attack Nya, so Lloyd jumps on it. Eventually, the Bounty still descends after one of the Dire Bats runs into the pole containing the sail. Although all hope seemed lost, the Army of Shintaro carry the ship while Hailmar greets the ninja and shows them the Kingdom of Shintaro in the horizon.

Into the Dark[]

The ninja are welcomed into the palace by King Vangelis. After hearing how Princess Vania is such a big fan of the ninja, especially Cole, Lloyd becomes suspicious of her. Mostly out of what happened with Harumi.

The Worst Rescue Ever[]

Lloyd and the other ninja are strolling through the magnificent gardens, and realize that Cole is missing.

Suddenly, Princess Vania appears from out of a tunnel in a frenzy, telling the ninja that she went into the Dungeons with Cole and found something terrible. There's an underground mine filled with little creatures forced to mine by black skeletons. Cole stayed behind to rescue them and told her to get help.

The seven of them go to tell King Vangelis, and he is angry at his daughter for disobeying his orders, endangering their guests. He says that he'll send his guards down at once to find Cole, but he will not allow the ninja to go. The ninja realize that the creature that Cole saw in his bedroom was real all along.

The ninja leave the throne room and make secret plans to enter the dungeons behind the King's orders. Vania agrees to show them the way into the dungeons, and she leads the way back to the garden.

Wu agrees to stay behind with Vania, feeling as though he'll slow the rest of them down. The ninja enter the cave and find that Vania was telling the truth. Zane detects simple weapons and crude fortifications from the skeletons, and the others suggest that they bust up the bags of bones, and rescue Cole nice and quickly.

They all agree, and steal the keys to Cole's cage, and free him at last. In order to delay their capture, Zane blocks an entrance off for the skeletons with his shuriken. Cole tells them to keep the volume down, as there's a winged masked man who lives in the temple in the center.

The two tribes of creatures that live in the dungeons, the Geckles and Munce, start to quarrel with each other, causing a ruckus. This alerts the Awakened Warriors, who begin to attack the ninja. Lloyd orders Jay and Nya to take our the warriors, while the rest of them run away. Zane and the others are in shock, watching the Geckles and Munce call each other "blade stealers." Meanwhile, the ninja find that the Awakened Warriors go down without much trouble.

While trying to defend themselves, Zane realizes that his Elemental Powers are no use in the dungeons.

All the commotion causes the masked man to exit his temple. The man reveals himself as the Skull Sorcerer, a masked man in a black gown with wings, wielding a glowing green skull. The Skull Sorcerer uses the green skull in his hands to awaken the black skeletons around him, overwhelming the ninja, leading to their defeat and eventual capture.

The Two Blades[]

Lloyd and the other ninja are put to work by the Awakened Warriors, forced to mine heaping amounts of Vengestone, which explains their inability to use their powers.

After causing a ruckus, they are locked up in a cage with several Geckles. When Gliff picks a fight with Murt, the ninja start to wonder where their feud started.

Gliff explains that long ago, a hero named "Gilly" (who the Munce argues was named "Milly,") entered the mountain with two blades to defend the Geckles and Munce from a terrible dragon known as Grief-Bringer (who the Munce argues was called "Mief-Bringer.") After defeating the dragon, "Gilly" left behind her blades as gifts to the Geckles and Munce — leaving the Ivory Blade of Deliverance to the Geckles, and the Shadow Blade of Deliverance to the Munce.

The two tribe's feud started when the Munce apparently stole their blade, however, the Munce argues that the Geckles were the ones that stole the blade. The ninja come to the conclusion that it was actually the Skull Sorcerer who stole both blades, in order to get control over both tribes. While the tribes fight over themselves, they can't fight the Skull Sorcerer.

Lloyd puts together a plan to get the two tribes to make a truce so they can all break out. Word is passed around through Geckles and Munce about a secret meeting after lunch, and when the time comes, they discuss retrieving both Blades by defeating the Skull Sorcerer.

Later, the ninja break out of their cages by getting a Minos to eat through their chains. The ninja split up, while Cole and Lloyd attempt to find the two blades, Zane and the others go about releasing the remaining Geckles and Munce. A few minutes later, chaos ensues, as Cole and Lloyd are chased away by the Skull Sorcerer.

In the commotion, the ninja are split up so that Jay, Nya, and Lloyd go one path, while Zane and Kai go down another. Cole is further separated from the group as he is chased by the Skull Sorcerer.

Queen of the Munce[]

Lloyd, Nya, and Jay follow the Munce to their home, but Murt can't remember where it is. Nya spots footprints and they follow it.

The ninja discover the beautiful cave and meet Queen Murtessa. She takes affection for Jay and thinks Nya is some sort of servant. Nya is furious at Murtessa and Lloyd tries to calm her down but also spots cave art depicting "Gilly" fighting a dragon.

The ninja eat with Murtessa and she flirts with Jay. Nya gets angry at Murtessa saying she is her love interest and both stare down each other. Lloyd tries to calm everything down, but Murtessa challenges Nya to a duel and she accepts it.

Lloyd witnesses Nya get beaten up by Murtessa, but Nya is able to perform Spinjitzu and knocks out the queen. The rest of the Munce then declare her the new queen, and Lloyd realizes they have a new problem.

Grief-Bringer[]

Lloyd watches as the Munce argue whether they should attend the truce meeting with the Geckles. Nya then gets the Munces' attention by using her Elemental Powers and forces the Munce to the meeting.

When they arrive, Lloyd and the ninja try to settle everyone down after tensions rise between the two tribes. Suddenly, they hear the sound of Grief-Bringer and everyone but Zane and Lloyd flee. The remaining ninja try to hold off Grief-Bringer, but he proves to be too strong as they also retreat.

The Darkest Hour[]

The ninja, Geckles, and Munce are running away from Grief-Bringer and decide to hide in the Geckle Strong-Cave.

When Nya and the Munce are trying to close the gate, Kai and the rest of the ninja head out to buy time for them to close it. The ninja perform Spinjitzu to defeat most of the Awakened Warriors, but they quickly rebuild themselves. Murtessa is able to break the chains to the gate and the ninja retreat back in.

Tensions once rise between the two tribes as Gulch is upset that the Munce are in his shelter.

Even though both sides dislike each other, they both are fearful when Grief-Bringer and the Awakened Warriors attempt to tear down the gate. Nya recognizes a pile of rocks covering something and asks the Geckles and Munce to work together to remove the rocks. Kai marvels at their teamwork, and when they're done, he enters first. However, he discovers there's no other way out.

Murtessa and Gulch apologize to each other and Kai and Nya officially establish peace with the opposing tribes. At the same time, the Skull Sorcerer destroys the gate and is about to fight until the ninja decide to surrender themselves and allow the Geckles and Munce to be free. The Skull Sorcerer agrees and the ninja are taken away.

The Upply Strike Back![]

Trapped in a Vengestone cage, Lloyd and the ninja observe the Geckles and Munce laboring in the mines. Lloyd reassures them that as long as the Geckles and Munce are unharmed, there is still a chance for hope. The Skull Sorcerer approaches and reveals to use Grief-Bringer upon the ninja to force the Geckles and Munce into submission, extinguishing their hope. Lloyd attempts to intimidate the Skull Sorcerer by mentioning Cole, believing that Cole is on his way to warn King Vangelis about the Skull Sorcerer. However, the Skull Sorcerer reveals himself to be Vangelis, having imprisoned Cole and Wu deep in Shintaro Mountain after they discovered his true identity, much to Lloyd's dismay. Despite Vangelis's revelation, Lloyd remains skeptical and questions him about the theft of the Blades of Deliverance. Vangelis admits to stealing the blades in order to exert control over the Geckles and Munce, solidifying his power over them.

In the midst of the execution ceremony, Lloyd and the ninja witness with trepidation as Grief-Bringer was on the verge of being set free. However, Cole steps in and confronts Vangelis, as the Shintarians engage in battle against the Re-Awakened. Plundar and Adam come to the rescue, freeing the ninja from captivity and enabling them to partake in the battle for Shintaro Mountain.

The Son of Lilly[]

Lloyd continues to fight the Awakened Warriors alongside the ninja, Upply, Munces, and Geckles. Despite being overwhelmed, they receive aid when Vania and the Winged Guards of Shintaro arrive as well.

After Cole unlocks the Spinjitzu Burst, Lloyd watches Vangelis being taken away by his former guards.

During the ceremony, Lloyd watches Vania becoming the new ruler of Shintaro and promises peace for everyone. After the ceremony is finished, the ninja wave good-bye as they board the Bounty. Lloyd also took this time to apologize to Vania for his distrust towards her which she accepts.

The Island

The Island[]

Uncharted[]

Staying awake the whole night, keeping surveillance on the missing Kryptarium inmates, Lloyd was met by P.I.X.A.L., who realizes Ronin was the one who arrested Fugi-Dove. Then, Cecil Putnam arrives, informing the ninja that Misako is presumed lost. Wanting to save his mother, Lloyd calls for an expedition to the uncharted island. First, they meet up with Twitchy Tim, who chooses to go with them to the island. He rides on a ninja's catamaran with the other ninja, and arrives at the island. He calls for the Jungle Choppers from P.I.X.A.L., and they ride them into the jungle.

The Keepers of the Amulet[]

Lloyd and the other ninja dismount off the Jungle Choppers in order to travel through the jungle. He senses Zippy's presence, who jumps at the ninja. Lloyd notes that even if he is friendly, they must focus on their mission. Later, Lloyd, along with the other ninja, get attacked by Stone Guardians. Lloyd brings the Golems off the ninja's trail by luring them away before hiding in a cave, where he meets up again with Twitchy Tim.

The Gift of Jay[]

Lloyd puts on camouflage to get into the Keepers' Village, he tries to motivate Twitchy to help him but he is scared, Lloyd still continues to go to try to free the Ninja. With Zippy’s help, he is a able to free them and helps the Ninja look for Jay. Only to be ambushed by the Keepers when he and the others try to convince Clutch to not steal the Storm Amulet. He is captured with the Ninja and forced to watch Jay be sacrificed to “Wojira”.

The Tooth of Wojira[]

Lloyd breaks free and tries to help Jay from being eaten, only to fail. They get back to the island to be met by the Keepers, who promise to sacrifice them if Wojira comes back. Lloyd shows a wooden tooth from the sea creature and tells the Keepers that they have been tricked and gets them to help the Ninja find Jay. Lloyd battles some of Ronin’s crooks and saves Jay. Later, he is thanked with the rest of the Ninja by Mammatus. Next day, he sits down at a beach and is confronted by Wu and Misako who ask what he is thinking about, he tells them he wonders if Wojira is an actual being or not.

The Virtues of Spinjitzu

The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

Curiosity[]

Lloyd entered the courtyard after Wu was shocked to see a giant hole in the middle of the wall. After Jay, Kai, and Nya failed to remember the six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu, Wu looked around to see if the other ninja remembered, but they all looked down with guilt on their face.

With the ninja forgetting the virtues, Wu ordered them to medidate immediately. While medidating, Lloyd was meditating the wrong way, so Wu turned his body to the right way. While Wu was attending to the door, Lloyd continued to medidate even when Nya heard a roar in the background. When Nya investigated by opening the door, they was shocked to see Wu grasped by a green dragon. The ninja tried to fight the dragon, but the dragon was able to deflect their attacks and escape through a portal. The ninja then entered the portal hoping to save their master.

Balance[]

The ninja exited the portal and saw the green dragon across a pool of lava. Having to get across, Lloyd decided to use the ledges on the permeter, but quickly encountered the Lava Monster. Fortuantely, he is saved by the Thunder Dragon and entered the next portal.

Wisdom[]

Teleporting from the pyramid, Lloyd found himself racing at the Speedway Five-Billion in his car. Trying to get a sense of his surroundings, he saw the Legendary Dragon teleporting through another portal. Suddenly, the Whack Rats appear and begin shooting at him with one of the Whack Rats jumping on his car. Lloyd questioned whether this was against the rules, but just before the Whack Rat bombed his car, Cole came from behind in his mech and tossed the rat aside. The ninja identified another portal at the finish line and tried to get to it with their vehicles, but the Whack Rats kept respawning every time they were defeated. Lloyd then realized they had to be defeated instead of defeating the Whack Rats and purposely got shot by the enemy. Although Lloyd "died" on purpose, he quickly respawns right near the portal. The rest of the ninja followed suit and were able to enter the portal.

Honesty[]

Lloyd and the ninja were trapped in a cage and watched as Kai and Jay jousted in order to earn their freedom. After Jay told the truth of falling in his win, the Ice Emperor was pleased Jay told the truth and freed the rest of the ninja. The Ice Emperor then opened the next portal for the ninja to find Wu.

Generosity[]

Lloyd and the ninja fought the Awakened Warriors in the Mines of Shintaro. After saving the Geckles from the warriors, the ninja used the catapult to launch themselves to the next portal.

Courage[]

Lloyd and the ninja found themselves on the Island of the Keepers with Lloyd in his race car. They discovered Wu held captive by the Legendary Dragon along with three other dragons surrounded by a forcefield. The ninja suggested different strategies, but Kai disregarded everything proposed by the ninja and took the dragons head on. After Kai destroyed the forcefield, he protected Wu from the Legendary Dragon by using his Elemental Powers as a shield while Lloyd drove his car into the dragon. Despite the ninja defeating the dragons and saving Wu, their master informed them it was merely a lesson to teach the six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu.

Seabound

Seabound[]

A Big Splash[]

Lloyd and the other Ninja made their way to the Farmers' village where they encountered Miss Demeanor and her Henchmen for the first time. When the villainess began to make a getaway, Lloyd ordered Nya and Zane to intercept her. Unfortunately, Nya's powers went haywire and she lost control over the waterspout she had created, forcing the ninja to shift their focus towards protecting the village over capturing Miss Demeanor.

Following the mission, Lloyd reported the circumstances to Wu and accompanied him to the Monastery's library where the ninja learned that the First Spinjitzu Master did not originally possess the powers of Water and Wind.

The Call of the Deep[]

Together with Cole, Lloyd worked on restoring power to the computers inside the Samurai X Cave. After the two succeeded in fixing the monitors, Nya entered and asked about the whereabouts of Zane and P.I.X.A.L., to which Lloyd hesitantly admitted that the two decided to embark on a mission to the Endless Sea on their own due to recent circumstances.

Later, Lloyd was washing the dishes when a strange pulse of energy caused the water in the sink to erupt from the faucet. He then joined the others in cleaning up the flooded Monastery.

Unsinkable[]

When Cole cryptically referenced the last time a ship was said to be "unsinkable," Lloyd cautiously gestured for Cole to drop the subject. He then turned towards P.I.X.A.L. and insisted that her newly designed Hydro Bounty was fantastic. At nightfall, Lloyd, Zane, Jay, Nya, and P.I.X.A.L. entered the vessel for their mission to Tartarus Trench, with Lloyd manning the ship's engines.

Some time into their voyage, Lloyd entered his quarters onboard the ship and spotted a Pillow mint on his bed. After enjoying the refreshing taste of the candy, Lloyd reminisced for a moment on its flavor before wondering how it could have possibly gotten there. After a brief investigation alongside Nya, Jay, and Zane, the four discovered that Nya's mother, Maya, had stowed onboard. In the ensuing conversation, Lloyd was delighted when Maya offered to make muffins, but he and the others were immediately called to the bridge, for they were arriving.

As the Hydro Bounty neared the trench, they were attacked by an unknown assailant and Lloyd responded in kind by launching the sub's torpedoes at their attacker.

Five Thousand Fathoms Down[]

While attempting to repair the damaged and powerless Hydro Bounty, Lloyd, Jay, and Zane stood outside of the engine room where they overheard Nya's argument with her mother. When Nya stepped out of the room, Lloyd began to sheepishly turn a valve, pretending to have been busy, but quickly began turning the valve in reverse after water began leaking through the hull.

When Nya and Maya prepared to deploy in the two APS suits, Lloyd encouraged Nya to allow her mother to join her, noting how his powers (and by extension the powers of the other ninja) would not be useful underwater, whereas Maya's status as the previous Master of Water could offer some helpful insight. He and the others then returned to the bridge where they watched Nya and Maya's surroundings thanks to the APS suits' cameras. After the pair arrived at the Temple of Wojira, Lloyd reacted with horror once Zane translated the door's engravings and discovered that the mentioned "Sleeper of the Deep," was in fact Wojira.

The Wrath of Kalmaar[]

Onboard the Hydro Bounty and having lost contact with Nya and Maya, Lloyd asked P.I.X.A.L. about how much oxygen the pair had remaining in their suits, growing concerned with P.I.X.A.L. estimated that both had about an hour left.

After another failed attempt at restarting power to the Hydro Bounty, Lloyd alerted the others that the hull was being breached with water and bemused that there surely had to be something else they could try to escape their predicament. When Jay sneaked off to attempt recharging the ship's battery, Lloyd, Zane, and P.I.X.A.L. ran after him, but it was too late. Once the batteries were charged, Lloyd called out to his friend but grew increasingly worried when Jay did not immediately respond. Fortunately, Jay survived the experience and all four returned to the ship's bridge to prepare for departure.

Long Live the King[]

After tracking down Nya and Maya's location, Lloyd and Jay geared up in their scuba suits and swam out to assist their allies, scaring off the Ripper Sharks with their Harpoon guns. After regrouping onboard the Hydro Bounty, the ninja were surrounded by a squadron of Maaray Guards who informed them that King Trimaar demanded their presence. With a frown, Lloyd told his allies that they didn't have a choice in the matter.

Lloyd and the others were then escorted to Trimaar's chamber, where the King demanded to know why they had trespassed upon his kingdom. In reply, Lloyd admitted that they were unaware even of the existence of Merlopia. He and the others then watched as Prince Kalmaar was brought in to answer to the accusations levied upon him and his ensuing coup. When Kalmaar blamed the ninja for mortally wounding his father, Lloyd led his allies in escape through the palace halls.

Escape from Merlopia[]

With only a wall of ice separating the ninja from a pair of pursuing Ripper sharks, Lloyd urged for his allies to search for a way to open the next door, suggesting that there could be a hidden lever or pressure plate. At that moment, the sharks breached the ice wall and nearly attacked Lloyd, though he managed to narrowly swim out of the way. Seconds later, he and the others would be pulled to the other side by Benthomaar, the adopted younger son of King Trimaar.

After introductions, Lloyd told Benthomaar that they didn't kill Trimaar, to which the latter responded that he already knew. Lloyd and the others then followed their new guide through the halls of the palace to the hanger bay where the Hydro Bounty was being kept. During the skirmish in the hanger bay, Lloyd commandeered one of the APS suits and offered to cover his friends' escape. With Nya's insistence however, Lloyd retreated alongside them, but not without hurling the suit's massive sword at Kalmaar and only narrowly missing the new king's head.

During the escape from Merlopia, Lloyd hitched a ride to the Hydro Bounty's exterior with the APS suit, only reentering the sub once they had lost their pursuers.

The Tale of Benthomaar[]

Lloyd listened closely as Benthomaar told the ninja about his history with Kalmaar. When the latter finished his story, Lloyd comforted the prince by declaring that the ninja would be proud to be his friends.

The Storm Amulet[]

On the way to the Island of the Keepers, Lloyd and his allies confirmed with Benthomaar that Kalmaar required both Amulets of Wojira in order to awaken the Storm Serpent. Lloyd then emphasized to his allies why securing the Storm Amulet was so important.

Upon arriving on the shores of the island, Lloyd and his allies established an audience with Chief Mammatus and warned him of the threat that was to come. After returning to the Hydro Bounty, Lloyd ordered P.I.X.A.L. to fire up the ship's radio so that they could contact the other half of their team that remained on dry land. Unfortunately, moments later, Kalmaar and his forces would storm the ship and damage it to the point of inoperability, stranding Lloyd and the others on the Island of the Keepers.

Riddle of the Sphinx[]

Stranded on the Island of the Keepers, Lloyd and his allies watched as Nya attempted to summon Whales to help tow the damaged Hydro Bounty. After she succeeded in doing so, Lloyd cheered his friend on, noting that they finally had a way off the island.

Master of the Sea[]

As they returned to Ninjago City, Lloyd listened on as Benthomaar told his allies the story of the Battle of Nine Days and of Nyad's sacrifice to defeat Wojira. At the conclusion of the story, Lloyd expressed hope that Kalmaar had not yet located the Storm Amulet.

After arriving at the docks of Ninjago City, Lloyd fought against the Maaray Guards in an effort to retrieve the Storm Amulet from Kalmaar. Following their seeming victory, Lloyd celebrated back at the monastery by playing Pool with Zane, Jay, and Benthomaar. As they played, Lloyd attempted to allay Benthomaar's fears of Kalmaar possibly retrieving the Storm Amulet by highlighting how Cole had taken it to be secured in Shintaro.

The Calm Before the Storm[]

Lloyd worked on repairs to the surviving APS suit at the Samurai X Cave. As he worked, he briefly used a fire extinguished on Kai's Submersible combat craft when it caught on fire. However, a second explosion knocked Lloyd and his APS suit off the platform ledge, though Lloyd managed to hoist himself up and declare that he was okay.

Assault on Ninjago City[]

During the Great Flood, Lloyd patrolled the submerged streets of Ninjago City in the APS suit. During his patrol, Lloyd rescued several kids from Benny's Arcade Emporium. After securing their safety, Lloyd attempted to engage in battle with Kalmaar and Wojira, but was blasted back into the water.

Nyad[]

Outnumbered and surrounded, Lloyd and the other patrolling ninja were forced to retreat to the Ninjago News Center. As Jay's condition worsened, Lloyd began pacing back and forth before shouting that they had to take Jay to a hospital.

The next morning, Lloyd and the others watched as Nya merged with the sea and set out to find Kalmaar to finish their battle once and for all.

The Turn of the Tide[]

In search of Nya, Lloyd and the others scaled their way to the top of the Ninjago City Police Station, where they fought against Gripe and his platoon of Maaray Guards. In the opening actions, Lloyd ripped into a Spinjitzu tornado and struck Gripe off the side of the building. After Kalmaar's demise and the guards' retreat, Lloyd and his friends watched as Nya returned in the form of a water dragon and fought against Wojira. Following Nya's victory, Lloyd watched with sad and solemn eyes as she returned to the sea and disappeared.

At Nya's memorial, Lloyd silently paid respects to his missing friend, being the first to empty his bowl of water into the vase.

After Seabound

After Seabound[]

The Sea Beast! (non-canon)[]

Following the Great Flood, Lloyd accompanied his fellow ninja in scouring the coastline of Ninjago for any signs of Nya. After being dropped off by P.I.X.A.L., Lloyd thanked her and stated that they would meet up with her south of the Golden Peaks in two days. After two whole days of walking up and down the coast and inquiring with the local fisherman for any leads, the ninja returned to Ninjago City with nothing but tall tales.

After returning to the harbor, Lloyd and the others spotted a large crowd gathered before a man who claimed to be selling a sea monster. However, after discovering that Miss Demeanor and her henchmen were amongst the prospective buyers in the crowd, Lloyd sprung into action, ready to foil Miss Demanor's sinister plans. Once the villainess was defeated and the monster was exposed as a fake, Lloyd and P.I.X.A.L. unmasked the mysterious vendor, discovering that he was none other than Ronin. In disgust, Lloyd asked the mercenary if he was even ashamed of himself before leaving him to the Police Commissioner, who decided to let Ronin off the hook this time as no actual crime had yet been committed. As the ninja began to walk away, Jay groaned that he was done with fake monsters and Kai poked fun at him, asking if he would prefer real ones instead. Upon hearing this, Lloyd let out a groan and asked both of them not to tempt fate for their next adventures.

Tentacles Below![]

A few days after the Great Flood, Lloyd patrolled Ninjago City to check up on the status of the city's recovery, reporting his findings back to Wu and Misako at the Monastery. After finishing his report, P.I.X.A.L. rushed out to inform Lloyd and the other Ninja that a monster was reportedly seen in the sewers of Ninjago City!

After investigating, the ninja quickly discovered the identity of the monster as being a baby Leviathan. Determined to get things over with quickly, Lloyd instructed his allies to attack the creature, at first with Spinjitzu, then with Jay's lightning when that failed. Zane however, quickly realized that the leviathan had no interest in attacking them but instead wanted to escape the sewers. When Lloyd's proposed ideas fell flat, Cole suggested instead for Zane to use his power of Ice to freeze some of the sewer water, then for Kai to melt it with his fire, creating a rushing wave that could move the baby leviathan. Throughout this process, Lloyd watched on in silence, questioning himself as to why he never thought of such ideas. Eventually, the levianthan was reunited with its parent: the same leviathan Zane had freed around Lighthouse Island many years ago. As the other ninja walked up into the lighthouse in search of a radio to contact P.I.X.A.L. with, Lloyd stayed behind and wondered to himself if he was still fit to lead the ninja.

Back to Merlopia![]

One afternoon following a training session, Lloyd and Wu responded to a visitor to the monastery. To their surprise, the visitor was none other than Merlopian scientist, Glutinous! From Glutinous, Lloyd and Wu learned that Gripe had returned alongside an army of renegade Maaray guards, intending to seize control over the underwater kingdom while Benthomaar was away. Lloyd quickly agreed to assist Gluntinous in repelling Gripe's attack, and the grateful scientist provided Lloyd with instructions to infiltrate the Merlopian Palace.

The next morning, the ninja cruised towards Merlopia onboard the Hydro Bounty. Armed with five APS suits, the five dove below the waves to Merlopia, briefly fighting against one of Gripe's patrols shortly after submerging. After arriving at the palace, the other four ninja immediately headed for the supply hatch that Glutinous told Lloyd about and began heading inside. As Lloyd watched his friends disobey his orders, he couldn't help but wonder to himself if his position as the team's leader was slowly slipping away.

Not long after entering the palace's halls, the ninja came across a platoon of Gripe's renegades, and Lloyd promptly ripped into a Spinjitzu tornado before swiftly defeating them. Overwhelmed, the rogue guards began to flee, with the ninja in pursuit. Believing that they could overtake and intercept Gripe's forces to the throne room, Lloyd ordered his allies to take one of the palace's lower tunnels. Unfortunately, Gripe had anticipated this course of action and ordered his forces to flood the lower tunnel, nearly drowning Lloyd and the others had it not been for Glutinous' timely intervention.

Shortly after, Lloyd and the others confronted Gripe outside of the throne room, but Gripe and his forces answered by simply locking themselves into the room. When Lloyd failed to find a way to open up the sealed doors, he began to lament how hopeless things seemed, adding that Nya could've probably solved this problem. Lloyd's complaints greatly angered Kai, who retorted that the ninja need a leader capable of taking action rather than wasting time. Kai then ripped into a Spinjitzu tornado himself, using the heat generated from his fiery vortex to melt away the doors before brutally beating Gripe and his forces, leaving Lloyd and the others to watch with aghast and horrified faces. After witnessing Kai's single handed victory, Lloyd admitted that the feat was impressive before handing Gripe over to Glutinous' custody. Although Gripe warned that he would never cease his attempts to seize the throne, Lloyd and the others departed now that the immediate threat had been quelled.

Bad Water![]

After a particularly intense training session, the ninja discovered that the water at the Monastery had been tainted with chemicals! Since the monastery drew its tap water from the same source that supplied Ninjago City, Lloyd suggested for the ninja to head over to the city to investigate. After wandering through the city, the ninja discovered that all of the city's water, even the canals, had been tainted. Lloyd then suggested to head upstream to continue their investigation, taking his Race Car to journey onward, following a heavily polluted river to discover the source of the contamination.

The ninja then discovered a mining operation hard at work near the polluted river; the Great Flood had apparently uncovered a new vein of vengestone, which was now being exploited by none other than Miss Demeanor and her henchmen, who were utilizing fracking techniques to obtain the mineral. Angered by the sight of Miss Demeanor, Lloyd vowed to defeat her once and for all this time, ordering the ninja to take on the illicit mining operation with Spinjitzu. Although this plan worked at first, Miss Demeanor's goons quickly turned the tables on the ninja by blasting them with contaminated water! Lloyd then admitted that his plan didn't work out while the others lambasted him for his suggestion. In frustration, Lloyd sarcastically asked if any of the other ninja had better ideas, to which Jay responded in the affirmative.

Following Jay's plan, all the ninja boarded his sub car and drove towards the mining operation to grab Miss Demeanor's attention. When she gave chase, as planned, Jay drove towards the polluted river and dove into it, converting his car to sub mode to traverse the contaminated waters. The goons on the other hand, were not so fortunate. Due to speeding on ahead in an effort to catch up with the ninja, the goons were unable to brake in time and crashed their mining vehicle into the river. Miss Demeanor, however, managed to escape once more, as her truck had been trailing the mining vehicle from behind. While Miss Demeanor escaped, Lloyd and the others made their way over to the submerged mining vehicle and rounded up the stranded henchmen. As he watched her escape, Lloyd tried to rally the other ninja into giving chase, but Cole called off the pursuit, explaining that the health of Ninjago City's citizens was more important and right now, they had to notify the Police Commissioner about their findings so that the river could be cleaned up.

Separate Ways[]

Lloyd and the others tried to convince many citizens that living in the city was safe, because due to the citizens fear of another flood, they started to illegally build houses on trees. Cole was able to convince the citizens by giving them a tour on the Destiny's Bounty. Lloyd was impressed by Cole's leadership and decided to sit his next mission out in order to think about his declining skills at being a good leader.

Lloyd would later abandon the ninja team and start working at a window washing company, spending the next months cleaning many windows in Ninjago City.

Crystalized

Crystalized[]

Farewell the Sea[]

Hoping to reunite the ninja, Cole, Kai, and Zane headed to Lloyd, who was washing windows in Ninjago City. Lloyd was taken aback by their unexpected presence and questioned why they were there. Kai explained that they needed to investigate the Vengestone matter and thought Lloyd's help would be valuable. However, Lloyd politely declined, mentioning his workload and the need to continue working. As he descended on the lift, Kai and Cole emerged from neighboring windows, desperately trying to bring Lloyd back to his senses. Cole reminded Lloyd of their ninja motto, but Lloyd snapped, stating that he was no longer willing to take responsibility for others. He declared that his sole focus now was on cleaning windows. Realizing that Lloyd needed some time, the ninja decided to try their luck with Jay instead.

At Lighthouse Island, the ninja witnessed a candlelight vigil. Lloyd joined them using an APS suit. Cole surprised at Lloyd's arrival, prompting Kai to ask what made him change his mind. Lloyd explained that Nya wouldn't want them to give up and would push them to continue working. In a show of unity, the ninja put their hands together in a circle and agreed to carry on for Nya.

The Shape of Nya[]

In the hangar bay, the ninja are engrossed in a heated discussion about the mysterious movement of Vengestone across Ninjago City. Zane suggested that it might be happening underground to avoid air traffic control. Lloyd chimes in, mentioning that the Serpentine have denied any activity in the unused subway tunnels, leaving the ninja puzzled about the situation and considering starting over with their investigation. When Lloyd turned to Jay for ideas, he remained silent, focusing on his glasses of water. Jay was disinterested and unmotivated to participate in the discussion about the Vengestone. Jay's sudden outburst catched the attention of the team as he reflected on Nya's absence and the impact it has had on their dynamic as a group. He expresses doubt about their ability to solve the mystery without her, leading to a tense exchange with Kai, who accused Jay of being mopey and unhelpful. The team's frustration and emotional turmoil reach a boiling point as they struggle to come up with a solution to the Vengestone mystery without Nya's presence. Lloyd suggested that they might all need a break due to the tension in the group. Jay dismissed the idea, claiming they already had all the information they needed. However, upon noticing a pizza box, Jay hinted at having an idea involving the N line.

Lloyd and the ninja reached the N line, where Jay explained that it had been closed for years and was now deserted. Jay pondered aloud whether someone else had taken over the construction of the subway tunnel after the city had abandoned it. Cole pointed out that they had reached the end of the tunnel, but Jay wondered if there was more to discover. Suddenly, they noticed a delivery man sleeping on a crate of Vengestone, waiting for the buyer. Miss Demeanor and her henchmen arrived. Lloyd quickly reminded Kai that they couldn't use their Elemental Powers due to the proximity of Vengestone. The ninja swiftly dodged Miss Demeanor's attacks and engaged in a fierce battle with her henchmen. However, they struggled to coordinate their efforts as a cohesive group. Miss Demeanor warned Lloyd about the New Ninja potentially replacing them, but Lloyd remained unfazed by the threat. In the midst of the chaos, a henchman was nearly knocked into Lloyd by Zane accidentally, and Jay ended up crashing into Lloyd as well. Just when things seemed dire, the New Ninja arrived and effortlessly defeated Miss Demeanor and her henchmen.

As the authorities escorted Miss Demeanor and her accomplices, Lloyd was prepared to express his gratitude to the Police Commissioner. However, to his surprise, the Police Commissioner diverted his attention and conveyed his appreciation for the exceptional efforts of the New Ninja instead. The Teal Ninja emphasized that their motivation was not to seek thanks, but rather to protect the vulnerable, which they found fulfilling. The Fuchsia Ninja clarified that they looked up to the ninja and were inspired by them to become ninja themselves. Lloyd defended their skills by highlighting their recent achievement of discovering a shipment of Vengestone and identifying the involved villains. However, the Fuchsia Ninja corrected him, stating that they only found the intermediaries and would have located the Vengestone Buyer if they hadn't intervened. The Teal Ninja then disclosed that they had planted a tracking device and intended to trace it to the final destination. The Orange Ninja mentioned that they had to depart as Ulysses Trustable wished to personally thank them. Finally, the team made their exit using a smoke bomb.

Lloyd was frustrated with the presence of the New Ninja at the hangar bay, questioning their identity and authority. Zane, however, explains that they are the New Ninja of Ninjago City and their arrival was actually fortunate. He emphasizes that without their assistance, the team would have likely faced defeat. Lloyd interrupts, stating that he was not interested in calculating the odds of their success, but rather wants to know how they will address the situation. Zane, oblivious to Lloyd's concerns, asks what specifically he is referring to. Lloyd expresses his distress over the fact that they are being replaced and questions whether Zane even cares about it. Cole intervenes, assuring Lloyd that nobody was replacing them and reminding him that Zane has turned off his emotion chip. The chaos triggers the sprinklers, and Master Wu rushes to the hangar bay to see what is happening. Suddenly, the ninja notice that the spilled water is glowing and shifting, and Nya emerges from within, taking on her humanoid form using the water. Nya explained that she must have her powers get taken away to get her human for back. In a surprising move, Zane freezes Nya in place using his Ice powers as a way to prevent Nya from losing her form. Cole asserts that Nya cannot have her Elemental Powers taken away, but Lloyd counters by reminding him of Kai's previous experience with Aspheera. Wu interrupts, firmly stating that considering such a plan is not an option and that they need to find another solution. Lloyd questions Wu about his search for alternatives to bring Nya back, to which Wu admits he has found none. Wu expresses his concerns about trusting Aspheera and the potential danger of releasing her from prison. He declares his unwillingness to be involved in this plan. Lloyd argues that having Nya back would increase everyone's safety. Cole acknowledges the significance of the decision and emphasizes the need for a collective team decision. Lloyd suggests taking a vote, but before he finishes his sentence, the ninja all raise their hands in agreement. Lloyd acknowledges the unanimous decision and declares their mission to save Nya by going after Aspheera.

A Mayor Problem[]

Lloyd and the other ninja paid a visit to City Hall to request for Mayor Trustable to release Aspheera from prison so that they could help restore Nya to her flesh and blood. When the mayor refused to grant such a request, Lloyd tried pleading with him, pointing out that the ninja owed a duty to Nya after all she had sacrificed to save Ninjago City from Wojira. Unmoved by this plea, the mayor reminded Lloyd that he too had a duty to the citizens of Ninjago City not to release an individual as dangerous and unpredictable as Aspheera.

Without any other options, Lloyd called Skylor to the Monastery before gathering the other ninja to share a plan he had in mind: if they couldn't release Aspheera legally, they would have to do it illegally. This line of thinking set Wu aback and he refused to be part of any illegal scheme concocted by his students, no matter how well intentioned they may be. With the other four ninja in agreement, Lloyd divided them up into two teams: Cole and Jay would head to Borg Tower to retrieve Aspheera's staff, while he, Kai, and Zane broke her out of Kryptarium. At this moment, Zane pointed out that he could not be part of the mission, as he had to remain to keep Nya's liquid form frozen and stable. No sooner had he said this, that Skylor finally arrived at the Monastery, revealing that Lloyd, having anticipated this prior, had requested her aid in copying Zane's power to take over for him. With Zane now free to accompany Lloyd and Kai, the five ninja set out to save Nya.

Several hours later, Lloyd, Kai, and Zane infiltrated Kryptarium Prison, clad in black stealth gi. After a brief moment of misidentifying one another due to their colorless gi, Zane noted that his role of freezing the heat detecting sensors in the prison would not work; instead, he opted to freeze both Kai and Lloyd, successfully lowering their body heat enough to fool the sensors! After the two defrosted, Lloyd and Kai shivered and tried to warm themselves up with a spark of fire generated by the latter before making their way down to Aspheera's cell.

As they approached Aspheera, the three ninja presented her with the plan they had in mind: come with them to drain Nya of her Elemental Power and Aspheera would be able to walk away free. After a moment of reluctance, Aspheera agreed to assist the ninja, who then freed her from her cell. As the four tried to escape back up to the hatch however, Aspheera accidentally knocked Zane's laser cutter out of his hand, triggering it and slicing through the steel cord that held Aspheera's former cell, causing it to crash to the ground below. This triggered a series of alarms across the prison, and the four quickly found themselves confronted by a sizable force of prison guards. After Kai's attempt at bluffing a reason for being in Aspheera's cell failed to land, the four were forced to run through the halls of the prison as they were pursued by the guards.

Public Enemies 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5![]

Having successfully escaped Kryptarium with Aspheera, Lloyd, Kai, and Zane hastily returned to the Monastery to save Nya. While Zane rushed on ahead to refreeze Nya's melting body, Lloyd and Kai showed Aspheera around the Monastery before bringing her down to the Samurai X Cave. There, Aspheera inspected Nya's watery form and wondered aloud as to what power could have changed her into such a state. Lloyd then answered Aspheera's question, speaking up to explain that Nya did this to herself by merging with the Endless Sea.

When Cole and Jay returned empty handed, P.I.X.A.L. asked Cyrus Borg for the whereabouts of Aspheera's staff, and he happily obliged. When the ninja reviewed the information provided to them by Borg, Lloyd noted that it would be difficult for the five ninja to hijack a fleet of four armored trucks - especially when it would be protected by a cadre of police officers. Zane agreed with Lloyd's assessment, but noted that modifications to the ninja's vehicles would be necessary to pull the job off successfully.

Eight hours later, Lloyd and the others embarked on their mission in their upgraded vehicles. As they drove, Lloyd expressed his sense of wonder towards P.I.X.A.L.'s engineering skills and asked how she managed to complete a six-hundred hour job in less than eight hours. P.I.X.A.L. declined to answer, instead only stating that she had her secrets. When she then began to explain how she had placed operating manuals within each individual ninja's vehicles, Lloyd cut her off and exclaimed to her and the others that they would have to figure things out on the fly, for time was not on their side. After identifying the specific armored truck that was carrying Aspheera's staff, Lloyd and the other three ninja with ground based vehicles boxed in the truck before setting their vehicles to auto-pilot. The four then boarded the truck while Zane deployed a magnetic winch to lift the truck into the air, flying off with it.

Unfortunately, not everything was going to plan, for the ninja would be surprised by the presence of the New Ninja inside this very truck! A fight soon broke out between the two groups of ninja, and during the scuffle, Lloyd was placed in a headlock and unmasked by the Teal Ninja who was shocked to see Lloyd's face underneath the hood. Briefly halting the fight, Lloyd told the New Ninja that he needed Aspheera's staff but emphasized he had no time to explain why. When the New Ninja hesitated, Kai attacked the Orange Ninja and relieved her of the staff, which was then caught by Jay. Lloyd and the other three then climbed aboard Zane's winch to escape as the armored truck and the New Ninja were safely set down onto the ground. As the ninja flew off to return to the Monastery, Lloyd sadly remarked that they were the bad guys now.

A Painful Promise[]

Returning to the Monastery with Aspheera's staff, Lloyd approached the Serpentine Sorceress, but hesitated as he recalled the damage she had inflicted years prior with the weapon. When Aspheera asked if Lloyd had changed his mind on their deal, Lloyd denied it and handed the staff to Aspheera before backing away. Although Aspheera at first seemed like she was able to uphold her end of the bargain, she instead turned on the ninja and began firing blasts of magic from her staff at them!

As Lloyd dove to hide from Aspheera's attacks, he exclaimed his disbelief at how Aspheera betrayed them already! This exclamation drew a snide comment from Wu, who sarcastically gasped that if only there had been a wise, old mentor who had repeatedly warned the ninja not to trust Aspheera! The sorceress' rampage would be briefly halted, however, by the Monastery's proximity alarms, warning that the New Ninja and the police had arrived outside the Monastery walls. While Aspheera was momentarily distracted, Lloyd seized this moment to rush up and attempted to wrestle the staff away from her, but was pushed aside.

When Aspheera decried the ninja as idiots and screamed that they would all now go to prison, Lloyd proposed a new deal to her: she drains Nya of her powers, and Lloyd would show her the secret exit out of the Monastery. With no other options, Aspheera complied with Lloyd's request while he and the other ninja held off the New Ninja from interrupting. Prior to the fight, Lloyd snidely pointed out to the Teal Ninja that his team needed a shorter catchphrase, emphasizing how his own team's catchphrase was only three syllables in length.

Once Aspheera succeeded in draining Nya of her powers and successfully restored her to her human form, Lloyd kept his promise and brought Aspheera to the secret exit, granting the sorceress her freedom. Lloyd then rejoined the other ninja in surrendering to the New Ninja and were placed in handcuffs before being directed to a police helicopter in the Monastery's courtyard.

Ninjago City vs. Ninja[]

Following their trial in Ninjago City v. Ninja, Lloyd and the others were convicted and now awaited sentencing. While some of the other ninja expressed their frustration and annoyance over their conviction, Lloyd remained silent throughout the entire sentencing process, only briefly gasping after the Honorable Judge William Toughbutt sentenced the ninja to five years in Kryptarium Prison.

Lloyd and the others were then brought to their cell in Kryptarium, where a small argument broke out when Jay slammed Zane for his lack of emotion or concern about their current situation. When Lloyd reminded Jay that Zane had deliberately turned off his emotions, Jay refused to withdraw his previous comments and instead emphasized how he would prefer for Zane to at least give a human response every once in a while. Kai then suggested that the ninja break out of Kryptarium, though Lloyd quickly shot this idea down, warning that they would only be breaking more laws if they did so. Instead, Lloyd suggested that they all wait for Dareth to come up with a legal way to have the ninja released from prison - an suggestion that was initially met with laughter by Kai who mistook it for a joke.

The next day, the ninja were let out into the prison's yard where several of the other inmates, including Ultra Violet, shot dirty glances at the ninja as they walked past. When Ronin approached the ninja and revealed his intentions of seeking revenge against them for busting his operation on the Island of the Keepers, Lloyd pushed back and firmly stated that the mercenary had no one to blame for his actions but himself, even going as far as to ask him when was the last time Ronin did anything for others that wasn't motivated by self interest. Before things could escalate any further, the Main Guard intervened, breaking up the squabble while informing Lloyd that a visitor had come to see him.

While the other ninja were returned to their cell, Lloyd walked down the hall with the Main Guard to meet the visitor, believing that it was Wu. As they walked, the guard expressed how he and several of the other guards admired the ninja and their actions in protecting Ninjago, emphasizing that their actions as prison guards was not personal by any means. Lloyd thanked him and insisted that neither he nor the other ninja would cause much trouble for the guards, much to the man's relief. Upon finally entering the visitor room, Lloyd was directed to booth ten, where he eagerly rushed to take a seat, hoping to see his uncle. Having had a glance at the visitor's straw hat, Lloyd immediately began to express his gratitude to his uncle for visiting, but was cut off prematurely when the visitor raised their head, revealing that it wasn't Wu at all, but rather a stranger wearing a kabuki mask.

Confused by the appearance of this stranger, Lloyd asked for him to identify himself. In response, the stranger only identified himself as being "A messenger of the Crystal King," and warned that the titular king was assembling an army of the ninja's past enemies to crush Ninjago. Horrified by these revelations, Lloyd demanded to know why the messenger was sent to tell him this, only to be met with an even colder reply: "Because I want to see the look of despair on your face. The look of helplessness as you see something you love, destroyed before your very eyes."

As the stranger got up and began leaving, Lloyd shouted at the guards to stop him, but to no avail. Unfortunately, with the stranger having committed no actions beyond simply speaking with Lloyd, a convicted prisoner, the guards did not recognize any threat from him; instead, they feared that Lloyd was attempting to create a diversion to escape! When the Main Guard and another guard stepped up to stop Lloyd, the Green Ninja leapt over them and made a dash for the exit, swiping the Main Guard's key card in the process! As Kryptarium's alarms flooded the halls, Lloyd rushed his way past many squadrons of guards, evading or fighting them off as he attempted to intercept the stranger from departing. In the end, unfortunately, the stranger was able to walk out of the prison gates, giving a taunting wave as he went while Lloyd was cut off on all sides by even larger forces of guards. With his quarry gone, Lloyd was forced to surrender and was taken back to his cell.

After being roughly shoved back into his cell with the other ninja, Lloyd told the others about his strange visitor and the ominous warning he was given about the coming of the Crystal King.

Kryptarium Prison Blues[]

Alongside the other ninja, Lloyd was let out of his cell to attend a visitation session with Skylor and Dareth, the latter of whom claimed to have discovered a way to have the ninja released from prison. Although Lloyd was the most open to Dareth's plan out of all the ninja, his hopes were dashed when Dareth revealed that his grand plan was to request a retrial on the grounds that they didn't like the judge's verdict, much to the frustration of Lloyd and the others. When the conversation pivoted to Vangelis' escape from prison, Lloyd realized that the Crystal King must have been behind it, divulging what he was told by the Kabuki Mask to Skylor and Dareth. Lloyd then ordered Dareth to hasten his legal research so that the ninja could get out of Kryptarium to investigate the mystery of the Crystal King. Although Dareth only grunted out that he had one last strategy to try, Lloyd and the other ninja were ordered back to their cell, for visitation time was up.

Around lunchtime, Lloyd sat with the other ninja in Kryptarium's courtyard, picking at bowls of green gloop. As they complained about the quality of the food, Lloyd remarked that Zane's can of oil was more appetizing and preferable over the stuff he was given. At that moment, Pythor, whom the ninja had not seen in years, approached their table and made several dismissive comments about them and there situation, infuriating Kai When the red ninja prepared to attack Pythor, Lloyd and Cole quickly restrained him, albeit only temporarily; unfortunately, Kai's temper was just too great and after shaking off his friends, Kai struck Pythor across the face with his serving tray, provoking a food fight with Pythor and several other inmates. This altercation would soon be halted by the Main Guard who ordered for all the prisoners involved to return to their cells. As they were led away, Pythor shouted, "All hail the Crystal King," causing Lloyd some concern.

Later that night, as Lloyd and the others tried to sleep, Lloyd spotted several Crystal Spiders crawling past them towards Pythor's cell. Realizing the threat they posed, Lloyd banged on Cole's bunk to wake him and the other ninja up before warning them about the threat. Even though escaping from their cell to pursue Pythor would only serve to worsen the ninja's image, Lloyd nevertheless agreed to allow Kai to melt their bars. Once their cell was compromised, Lloyd and the others then rushed off to intercept Pythor from escaping. As they pursued their old foe, Lloyd and the others were pursued as well by the prison's guards, all of whom were determined to prevent the ninja from escaping. Although Lloyd tried to tell the guards that they were only trying to prevent Pythor from escaping, his pleas fell on deaf ears and ultimately, the ninja were forced to stand back when the Crystal Spider that Jay took out activated its self destruct mechanism. Before the mechanical spider could explode, Lloyd shoved the pursuing guards behind where they would be safe from the blast. Unfortunately, this selfless action would fail to reflect positively on the ninja, for the guards already believed that the ninja were attacking them, and to make matters worse, Kai's reckless attempts at stopping Pythor from escaping had resulted in one of the external watchtowers being set ablaze. As many more guards now descended upon the ninja, Lloyd could do nothing more but surrender.

Hounddog McBrag[]

Lloyd and the other ninja were awoken by the Main Guard to report for work. As he exited their cell, Lloyd responded to his teammates' groans by pointing out that being put to work could be an opportunity to prove that they were not going to cause any further trouble. Lloyd also reminded his friends not to use their powers to assist in whatever work they were to be assigned before all five ninja were herded onto a prison bus. After taking a seat in the back of the bus, Lloyd and the others learned that they would be cleaning up litter from Route 22.

As the bus traveled alongside the Sea of Sand and briefly stopped for the guards to assist an elderly man with a broken engine, Lloyd and the others moved to the front of their section to watch the ongoing situation. Seconds later, Nya landed behind the prison bus in her new Samurai X Mech and tore open the backdoor, allowing for Lloyd and the other ninja to escape. The elderly man then drove his van over to where the ninja were hiding and gestured for them to board, taking off at high speed and leaving the guards behind!

After driving for some time, the man pulled off his hat and fake beard, revealing his identity as none other than Dareth, who explained that this was the last resort he had in mind for getting the ninja out of prison. Dareth's evoked a horrified look from Lloyd, but he did not have much more time to dwell on matters, for a police cruiser had activated its sirens and was now pursuing Dareth's van! After shaking off the police cruiser, Dareth's engine actually gave out, forcing Lloyd and the others to put on the new uniforms provided by P.I.X.A.L. and traverse the desert on foot. By nightfall, with the Ninjago Police combing the desert in search of the ninja, Lloyd was forced to make a difficult decision. Fearing that they would soon be caught again should they stick together, Lloyd split the ninja up into two groups: he would go alongside Jay, Cole, and Fugidove in one direction while Kai, Zane, and Dareth would go the other. Their objective was to find Twitchy Tim's gas station to ask their old ally for his assistance. When Cole asked what would they do should one group fail to arrive by noon the next day, Lloyd reluctantly admitted that they would have to assume the late group had been captured and move on without them. With no further questions, Lloyd and his group began wandering further into the desert.

The Fifth Villain[]

Continuing to wander across the Sea of Sand with his team, Lloyd paid no mind to Jay's increasing aggravation with Fugi-Dove, though he would on occasion poke fun at Jay's expense. Eventually, the group discovered a highway in the Sea of Sand and realized that they were close to Twitchy Tim's gas station. At this point, Fugi-Dove decided to give Jay his first lesson in crime and produced a bottle of water, which he then emptied onto the parched sands before dropping the bottle onto the ground, declaring that he had successfully committed the crime of petty vandalism! Once more, Lloyd paid no attention to Fugi-Dove's antics until the former expressed his hope that such actions would grant him a seat on the Crystal Council. Being alerted to the words "crystal" and "council," Lloyd pressed Fugi-Dove for more details and then decided that the ninja would have to capture and replace the next likely candidate to be invited to said council.

Eventually, Lloyd and his group arrived at Twitchy Tim's gas station, where they were warmly greeted by the namesake proprietor. Upon hearing Twitchy say his name, Lloyd smiled warmly and remarked with surprise that Twitchy remembered his and the other ninja's names. He then listened on to Twitchy's explanation that he now practiced ways to remember things before entering the store to enjoy a cool and refreshing drink of water. In the gas station, Lloyd relayed to Kai and Zane his plan of deducing the next likeliest candidate to be invited into the Council of the Crystal King and impersonating them to infiltrate the council. In the ensuing discussion, Lloyd shot down suggestions of Killow, Ultra Violet, or Captain Soto being the next likely invitee, dismissing them all as being small time criminals and urging for the ninja to think bigger. When the ninja finally settled on the Mechanic as possibly being the next invitee, Lloyd suggested that it would be worth paying him a visit, for they already knew the location of his secret lair in Ninjago City. As the the ninja prepared to leave, Hounddog McBrag and his squadron pulled up outside and ordered for the ninja to surrender, prompting for Lloyd and the others to dive behind the gas station counter for cover. Unfortunately, when the police entered the store to search for the ninja, Twitchy almost immediately gave away the ninja's hiding spot, much to Lloyd's chagrin. Fortunately, Fugi-Dove revealed himself and attacked the officers to take attention away from the ninja just long enough for them to escape outside. Taking one of the police SUVs, the ninja climbed aboard and sped off to Ninjago City.

Night had fallen by the time the ninja returned to Ninjago City and investigated the lair of the Mechanic. Although the derelict arcade seemed devoid of any sign of the once small time crook, the presence of many robo arms suggested his lingering presence. As Lloyd inspected one of these robo-arms, the Mechanic revealed himself and ambushed Lloyd, attacking him with the lair's many mechanical arms. After being freed by Jay, Lloyd called for his allies to attack the Mechanic, declaring that they could not let him escape.
